hazards.evidence: Only one side of the staircase has a handrail, which could make it difficult for someone using a walker to maintain balance and support on the other side.
The handrail appears to be made of wood and may not be graspable or stable enough for someone using a walker to rely on for support.
The couch in the living area has no armrests, which could make it difficult for someone using a walker to rise from a seated position safely.
